title: UNIHIKER K10
subtitle: All-in-one AI coding board with Vision, Voice & TinyML
desc: One board, four AI models — face, pet, QR & motion detection out of the box!
fullDesc: Explore a complete AI + IoT learning board built around the ESP32-S3. UNIHIKER K10 packs a 2.8" color touchscreen, camera, microphone, speaker, and a full environmental sensor suite onto a single board — so beginners can run real vision, voice, and TinyML projects with zero extra wiring, then graduate to MicroPython and PlatformIO as their skills grow.
author: Nikhil
innovation: A single classroom-ready board that runs offline vision AI, offline voice recognition, and on-device TinyML training — removing the need for cloud connectivity or extra modules in beginner AI education.
problemStatement: Most AI/IoT learning kits require assembling multiple modules (camera, mic, sensors, screen) before students can even start coding, which slows down classroom adoption and increases cost and failure points.
solutionApproach: UNIHIKER K10 integrates the camera, mic, speaker, screen, and sensors onto one ESP32-S3 board with four pre-loaded vision AI models, offline voice recognition, and TinyML support — letting students go from unboxing to a working AI demo in one sitting, using Mind+ blocks or MicroPython.

hardwareSpecs.dimensions: Single-board form factor with edge connectors — approx. 70×95mm

components: 3.7V LiPo Battery or 3x AA/AAA (optional, for portable power)
guide: Connect UNIHIKER K10 to your computer via the USB Type-C port
Install Mind+ (or your preferred IDE) and select the UNIHIKER K10 board
Press button B on-device to cycle through built-in demo modes (voice, sensor, tutorial)
Try a pre-loaded vision model — point the camera and test Face Detection or QR Code Scanning
Wake the board by voice ("Jarvis" or "Hi Telly") and issue a spoken command
Switch to MicroPython for more control, using the on-board editor or VS Code
Connect an external Gravity sensor to the edge connector and read live values on the touchscreen
